properties.displayName: MAS - Manual attestation for Implement Automated Data classification and retention policies
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Implement controls to manage and retain information within the system and its outputs in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and operational requirements, with continuous monitoring and periodic reviews. (Data-Security-63).

metadata.Description:
Automated Classification
Geolocation-Based Retention
Deletion Approval Workflow

for more details - refer to Control statement
"Automated Classification
- Machine learning algorithms automatically classify data based on content and context
- Data is tagged with relevant metadata including data type, sensitivity level, and applicable regulations
Consistent Tagging Across Clouds
- Implement a standardized tagging system across all cloud platforms
- Tags include retention periods, data owner, and compliance requirements
Policy-Driven Retention
- Define retention policies based on data classification, regulatory requirements, and business needs
- Automatically apply retention periods to data based on its classification and tags
Geolocation-Based Retention
- Implement location-aware retention policies to comply with regional data residency requirements
- Ensure data is retained in specific geographic locations as required by regulations
Automated Data Deletion
- Schedule automatic deletion of data that has reached the end of its retention period
- Implement secure deletion methods to ensure data cannot be recovered
Deletion Approval Workflow
- For sensitive data, implement an approval workflow before deletion
- Maintain audit trails of all deletion activities"
metadata.controlTitle: Implement controls to manage and retain information within the system and its outputs in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and operational requirements, with continuous monitoring and periodic reviews.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
